references.text: Continues the same argument about the fear that future generations will be excluded from worshiping the Lord
Further explains the purpose of the altar as a witness between the tribes
Similar concern to preserve testimony for future generations who ask about its meaning
Parallel situation where children ask about the meaning of a religious act
Same pattern of setting up memorials to answer questions from future generations
Children asking fathers about the meaning of stones as a memorial
Abraham shows similar concern for future claims and rights
